result.title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
result.summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Audio-Visual Rearrangement 任务：智能体听取语音请求，定位说话人并取送目标物体，构建了含显式指定、说话人相对空间指代与隐式意图三类查询的数据集，并在音视频 LLM 中加入运动感知空间音频模块，配合多任务指令微调辅助监督语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其随运动持续更新的空间音频状态表示与多任务辅助监督，可能为 LVR 中任务必要空间信息的内部保持及训练信号贡献分配提供可核查线索，但论文本身面向具身取送任务，非 latent 推理研究。
